items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Myself on the trumpet, and there was Milton Fletcher and this other fellow, I forget his name, yeah. Eddie Fantom on trombone, Judge George Dunlap on trombone, yeah.

ctx.x: Jazz -- that's Mike's -- what we called him. Wait a minute -- Dunlap, his name's Dunlap. We called him --
